g.text: fig 4 — step 2: fold the 1D window into k 2D maps

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #898781

g.text: each period p gives a different fold: a ROW is one period laid out left to right, a COLUMN is one phase seen across successive periods.

text.style: font-size: 9.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #898781

g.text: The fold is exact and reversible — reshape back and truncate recovers the window to floating-point precision. Where p does not divide T the series is zero-padded first (dashed line): p = 19 needs 6×19 = 114, so 18 zeros are appended.
